svg.title: Tuvok Leaflet — editable SVG
svg.desc: Editable vector reconstruction of Tuvok leaflet overlay over linked leaflet artwork. Text, colored panel frames, header bars, and legend are vectors; token and die symbols link to individual assets. Raster icon instances replaced with embedded SVG vector shapes; original text preserved.

g.aria-label: Vector banner header with editable Tuvok rank and name

text.tspan: They must reveal their hand to you.
this before their first reroll. You can control their
first reroll attempt or force them to skip it.
(This token may not be removed or transferred by any means.)

g.text: You may activate only one of these
Spend x: During any Roll Phase add x

of your deck. Put it back on top or bottom.

svg.title: Targeted token
svg.desc: Flat vector crosshair and person emblem.

g.text: When a player afflicted with this
token is attacked by an opponent, the
attacker increases their damage by 2. This is an
Attack Modifier and persists until removed.
A player with this token may spend
it at any time to prevent half of their
incoming damage, rounded up. If two Protect
tokens are spent against the same attack, both
independently halve the damage. Protect gained
from a Defensive Ability may be spent immediately.
